metrics.profile_summary: Results-driven MBA graduate specializing in digital marketing with a strong foundation in social media management and content creation. Experienced in executing multi-channel campaigns and leveraging data analytics to drive brand engagement.

experience.description: Executed digital marketing campaigns across social, email, and search engines, collaborating with creative teams to ensure Sharia-compliant branding.
Developed social media strategies and curated content for Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram, managing daily scheduling and community interactions.
Assisted in digital marketing strategies, managed content calendars, and developed SEO-optimized website content and ad campaigns.

strengths: Strong academic background with an MBA
Relevant certifications from Google and Hubspot
Direct experience in content scheduling and social media management
weaknesses: Does not meet the minimum 2-year professional experience requirement
Experience consists primarily of short-term internships and a brief executive role
evaluation.summary: The candidate is technically well-equipped and educationally overqualified, but lacks the required years of professional experience specified in the JD.
